messages:
mia: quick sync — we need a concise ownership map for the new canary/dashboard metrics before next week's rollout. can we list the runtime + infra inputs and who will own panels/alerts? 2pm quick huddle?

devin: +1. sharing a starter list below of candidate signals we should show in the compare view. want owners for each so console team can wire panels.

devin: candidate signals: token_latency_p50, token_latency_p95, request_qps, avg_batch_size, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_memory_bytes, gpu_util_pct, request_retries, fallback_rate, route_weight, quota_rejections, embed_time_ms. also include per-model-variant and per-region labels.

lee: re: cardinality — please avoid free-form request tags. owners need to pick dimensionality: {model_variant, route, region, deployment_tier}. otherwise dashboard panels will explode.

anita: +1 on dims. propose aggregation tiers: 1) shard-level (for perf), 2) route-level (for product), 3) global (for health). Also: sampling policy for traces/latency (1% heavy-weight traces by default).

sam: we also need regression signals. suggestion: compute treatment_vs_control deltas for p95 and error-rate with an attribution window (30m). if delta > threshold and bootstrap p<0.01 flag as regression. We should encode this in telemetry so console can surface a single "regression" boolean per comparison.

pratik: tiny telemetry schema proposal to attach to events (this is minimal):
```
metric_name: string
value: float
labels: {model_variant, route, region, tier, routing_policy, quota_source}
event_ts: unix
compare_group: optional string (control|treatment)
```
This keeps things queriable in the metrics backend.

mia: looks good. specific asks for owners: can each of you volunteer? i'll coordinate panel templates.

devin: I can own token_latency_p50/p95 + avg_batch_size panels (devex/console will implement UI).

lee: I'll own kv_cache_hit_rate, gpu_util_pct, model_memory bytes (eng-runtime).

anita: I'll take request_qps, request_retries, fallback_rate (eng-sre) and draft alert thresholds for sustained deltas.

sam: I'll own the regression signal implementation and the compare calculation (eng-platform). will add a small job to emit comparison events.

pratik: I'll wire the telemetry tags and publish the JSON schema to the telemetry repo, plus sample ingest config for the metrics pipeline.

mia: perfect. next: UX for compare mode. console team — we need a compact summary card: 1) pass/fail (regression flag), 2) top-3 regressed metrics with % delta, 3) link to full heatmap. any constraints?

devin: limit card rows to 3 metrics and show absolute + relative change. use sparklines for last 1h. add a small button "open diff" that preloads treatment/control.

lee: we should include a sample query pattern for the backend to power the sparklines. I'll post a draft query after lunch.

anita: alerting rules: for now keep noise low — only page on sustained regressions (p95 delta > 20% for 30m) or availability drops > 5% sustained. everything else goes to a ticketing stream.

mia: can each owner drop one sample panel config and a suggested alert threshold by EOD tomorrow? I'll consolidate and create an ownership matrix.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: metrics-ingest-pipeline v2.14 rolled back on infra-3 at 1765509401 — ingestion realtime window extended.

sam: noted the rollback — will add a fallback for compare job to skip windows with missing data.

devin: quick note — include route tagging for quota_source in panels. otherwise we can't tell dedicated vs hosted behavior.

pratik: noted. also will add a small example to telemetry repo showing label values for quota_source: [hosted, dedicated, private].

mia: awesome. last step: owners add entries to the shared spreadsheet under "canary metrics mapping" and ping me when done. i'll run the 2pm sync and produce a short checklist for console wiring. :thumbsup:
